name: Browser Extract
description: Extract data from a live browser session, or from HTML/JSON content.
doc: Pick what to extract from the dropdown — most workflows only need one node: Live page (needs Session input): • Text - cleaned visible text • Links - all anchors with text + href • Images - elements with src/alt/dimensions • Emails - addresses from mailto and visible text • Phones - numbers from tel and visible text (region-aware) • Colors - brand color palette • Run JavaScript - run a custom script and get a JSON result Content (needs Content input — string of HTML or JSON): • CSS Selector - elements from HTML • Regex - pattern matching • JSON Path - navigate JSON

inputs.name: Session
inputs.description: Browser session for live extraction (text, links, images, emails, phones, colors, JavaScript)

inputs.name: Content
inputs.description: HTML or JSON string for selector / regex / jsonpath

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Extracted data (shape depends on Extract type)

properties.name: Selector / Scope
properties.description: CSS selector. For text/links/images this scopes the search; for 'CSS Selector' this is the pattern.

properties.name: Attribute
properties.description: Attribute to extract: text, href, src, or any HTML attribute

properties.name: Script
properties.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the page

properties.name: Region
properties.placeholder: AU, US, UK, CA, NZ, IN, DE, FR, GENERIC
properties.description: Phone-format region for the regex. Tuned for AU/US/CA/UK/NZ/IN/DE/FR; anything else falls back to GENERIC.

properties.name: Same Origin Only
properties.description: Filter links to the same origin as the page
